object_description: two new buildings forming a shared courtyard
design_condition: Two new buildings and the existing gymnasium form a break area connected to the village square by an east-west route, but the cemetery edge, restricted cross-site relationship, and building scale make the setting unacceptable.

positive.statement: The two new buildings create a well-sized break area and a new important east-west connection.

position.rationale: The shared open zone between the two masses is clearly visible in plan.

positive.statement: The horizontal staggering of the different areas is architecturally very well formulated.

position.rationale: Horizontally offset building parts are distinct in the top view and elevations.

positive.statement: Attractive multi-story rooms connect the uses and allow for exciting visual connections.

position.rationale: The connecting spatial zone is approximated between the staggered building parts.

positive.statement: The spacious foyer is appropriate for the hall and beautifully designed.

position.rationale: The foyer is assigned to the lower portion of the larger right-hand building.

positive.statement: The design of the buildings with a concrete base and wooden structure above is architecturally well thought out and integrates the buildings in context.

position.target: concrete base and wooden structure above
position.rationale: The visible facade envelope anchors the described base-and-upper-structure composition.

positive.statement: The project is sensitive and designed to a high architectural standard, with strong spatial qualities and organization of the spatial program.

position.target: overall spatial qualities and program organization
position.rationale: The two-part organization and shared courtyard are legible across the sampled model.

negative.statement: The proposed situation is considered inappropriate from a local planning perspective.

position.rationale: The planning judgment is anchored broadly to the complete site arrangement.

negative.statement: The proximity of the break area to the cemetery is criticized and its demarcation remains unresolved.

position.rationale: The break area is placed toward the northern cemetery-facing edge.

negative.statement: The placement along the street would massively restrict the important relationship between the two school buildings.

position.rationale: The street-facing edge is used to approximate the obstructing building placement.

negative.statement: The granularity and size of the school building construction are controversially discussed.

position.target: granularity and size of school construction
position.rationale: The large-grained massing is visible in the two building volumes and their separation.

negative.statement: The lying community hall is unconvincing because of its poor proportions.

position.rationale: The low horizontal hall is approximated within the lower right-hand volume.
